name: rakshak-net-workspace
description: Rakshak Sensors - Live Pedometer, Gyroscope, Magnetometer, Accelerometer, Ambient Light Sensor app with Capacitor, Android Studio, Svelte 5 and shadcn-svelte

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.sync:android: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.open:android: cd frontend && npx cap open android
